name: Hummingbird UI Kit
description: A free, open-source UI kit powered by Hummingbird Tailwind component library. Colors, themes, typography and 50 components, ready to copy into any HTML project.

items.name: Colors
items.description: Semantic colors, surface and text tokens, and the full color palette.

items.name: Themes
items.description: Light and dark mode out of the box, plus eight prebuilt color themes.

items.name: Typography
items.description: Headings, display text, paragraphs, lists, blockquotes and inline text styles.

items.name: Basic
items.description: Buttons, badges, avatars, loaders, progress bars and other building blocks.

items.name: Navigation
items.description: Navbars, tabs, breadcrumbs, pagination, list groups and scrollspy.

items.name: Overlays
items.description: Modals, offcanvas panels, dropdowns, tooltips, popovers and toasts.

items.name: Feedback & Data
items.description: Alerts, cards, accordions, carousels, tables and custom scrollbars.

items.name: Content & Layout
items.description: Grid, columns, containers, images, video, backgrounds and shadows.

items.name: Forms
items.description: Inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, switches, ranges and validation.

items.name: Advanced Forms
items.description: Searchable selects, date & time pickers, range sliders and file uploaders.

themes.name: Default
themes.description: The signature Hummingbird theme with balanced neutrals and vibrant blue accents.

themes.name: Luxury
themes.description: Rich maroon and golden tones crafted for a refined, premium appearance.

themes.name: Retro
themes.description: Warm vintage-inspired colors that bring a classic and timeless feel.

themes.name: Arctic
themes.description: Cool blues and frosty tones inspired by modern winter landscapes.

themes.name: Nature
themes.description: Fresh greens and earthy shades inspired by the natural world.

themes.name: Dracula
themes.description: Deep purples and vivid pinks designed for bold, high-contrast interfaces.

themes.name: Ember
themes.description: Warm oranges and amber tones that create an energetic, glowing aesthetic.

themes.name: Midnight
themes.description: Deep blues and indigos designed for calm, modern dark experiences.
